title: Pseudo-Planche Push-Up
summary: A push-up with your hands turned out by your hips and your body leaning forward, which shifts the load to the front delts.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.9 for front delts (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.8 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.7 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.2 for biceps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Set your hands by your lower ribs with your fingers turned out, and lean forward.
Lower while keeping the forward lean.
Press back up without losing the lean.

form_cues.cue: Lean less if your wrists complain.

mistakes.text: Losing the lean so it becomes a normal push-up.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Easier to learn.
